// lib: ES2020 only — deliberately no DOM and no @types/node. This is the runtime
contract expressed as a compiler setting: `document`, `window`, `fetch`,
`setTimeout`, `Buffer` and `process` are compile errors inside src/, not
just lint findings. Do not add 'DOM' or 'types': ['node'] here.
// extensions: Relative imports carry the .ts extension so Node can run src/ directly via
type stripping (tests import ../src/index.ts with no build step).
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions rewrites them to .js on emit.
